name: US-01 Explain new-baby starting points and their foundations

messages.content: This is a synthetic beginner journey. I have just had a baby and want to know which official starting points I should check. Use the page evidence only. First call explore_answer_foundations with answerId `answer:new-child-starting-points` and claimId `claim:register-a-birth`. Then call compare_evidence_foundations with that answerId and claimIds [`claim:register-a-birth`, `claim:check-child-benefit`, `claim:check-parental-pay-and-leave`] in that order. Explain the result in plain English, separate what is supported from what still depends on my circumstances, and include the official links supplied by the tools.
